{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CgPFXivXoaY63XwaLs4gY","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Accounts\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load accounts <csv>`, which loads accounts from a CSV file all-or-nothing. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-Count.md |\n| Provides | ledger load accounts |\n| Consumes | cli.main, parse_amount, validate_code, validate_text |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nBulk-load account rows from a CSV file so the shop's drawers, safe, and petty cash exist before\ntransactions are loaded. The command either stores every row or stores nothing.\n\n## Command Contract\n\n`ledger load accounts <csv>` registers under the `load` command in the cli command table.\n\n| Condition | Result |\n|---|---|\n| File readable, header equals `account,name`, every row valid | Exit 0. Stdout is `table,loaded` then `accounts,<rows>`. |\n| Missing `<csv>` argument or extra arguments | Exit 2, nothing on stdout. |\n| File missing or unreadable | Exit 1, nothing on stdout. |\n| Header differs from the table columns in name or order | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| A row has an invalid code or name (see Rules 3 and 4) | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| A code repeats within the file | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| A code already exists in the `accounts` table | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Read the whole file and parse it with the standard `csv` module.\n2. Check the header, then check every row with the `ledger-core` validators, the duplicate-in-file\n   rule, and the duplicate-in-table rule. All checks complete before the first write.\n3. Write every row in one transaction through the persistence library, then print the result.\n4. A failing command writes one diagnostic line to standard error and nothing to standard output.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: detect codes already stored - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n\nRows are written through `db.accounts.create`, the operation declared for the account feature in\n`DATABASE.md`; this feature reuses it and declares no operation of its own.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-accounts-valid ===\nIntent: A valid accounts file loads, reports the loaded count, and every row reads back.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef counts():\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert rc == 0\n    return {r[0]: int(r[1]) for r in list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))[1:]}\n\ncodes = [\"LDACC1\", \"LDACC2\", \"LDACC3\"]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n    path = os.path.join(tmp, \"accounts.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerows([[c, \"Name \" + c] for c in codes])\n    before = counts()\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert rc == 0\nrows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert rows == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"accounts\", str(len(codes))]]\nassert counts()[\"accounts\"] == before[\"accounts\"] + len(codes)\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for c in codes:\n        got = db.accounts.get(account=c)\n        assert got is not None\n        assert got.name == \"Name \" + c\n=== END AC load-accounts-valid ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-header ===\nIntent: A file whose header does not match the table columns is rejected with exit 3 and stores nothing.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode = \"LDHDR1\"\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n    path = os.path.join(tmp, \"accounts.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"code\", \"label\"])\n        w.writerow([code, \"Wrong Header\"])\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert rc == 3\nassert out == \"\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n=== END AC load-accounts-header ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-atomic ===\nIntent: An invalid row rejects the whole file so no earlier row is stored.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ngood = \"LDATM1\"\nbad = \"bad code\"\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n    path = os.path.join(tmp, \"accounts.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerow([good, \"Good Row\"])\n        w.writerow([bad, \"Bad Row\"])\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert rc == 3\nassert out == \"\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=good) is None\n=== END AC load-accounts-atomic ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-duplicates ===\nIntent: A code repeated inside the file, or already stored, is rejected with exit 3 and nothing is added.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ndef counts():\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert rc == 0\n    return {r[0]: int(r[1]) for r in list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))[1:]}\n\ndef write(path, rows):\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerows(rows)\n\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n    dup_file = os.path.join(tmp, \"dup.csv\")\n    write(dup_file, [[\"LDDUP1\", \"One\"], [\"LDDUP1\", \"Two\"]])\n    before = counts()\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", dup_file)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert rc == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert counts() == before\n\n FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Transactions\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load transactions <csv>`, which loads transactions keeping their file ids, all-or-nothing. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md |\n| Provides | ledger load transactions |\n| Consumes | cli.main, parse_amount, validate_text, validate_date, balance_guard, ledger load accounts, ledger load categories |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nBulk-load transaction rows. Each loaded transaction keeps the `txn_id` written in its file. The\ncommand either stores every row or stores nothing.\n\n## Command Contract\n\n`ledger load transactions <csv>` registers under the `load` command in the cli command table.\n\n| Condition | Result |\n|---|---|\n| File readable, header equals `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, every row valid, resulting balances non-negative | Exit 0. Stdout is `table,loaded` then `transactions,<rows>`. |\n| Missing `<csv>` argument or extra arguments | Exit 2, nothing on stdout. |\n| File missing or unreadable | Exit 1, nothing on stdout. |\n| Header mismatch; non-integer `txn_id`; bad date, amount, or memo | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| Unknown account or unknown category | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| A `txn_id` repeats within the file or already exists in the table | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| Loading would leave any account balance below zero | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Read the whole file with the standard `csv` module and check the header.\n2. For each row validate the id, the date (a real calendar date), the amount (`-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`,\n   never zero, parsed to integer cents), the memo (0 to 60 characters, no comma or newline), and\n   that the account and category exist.\n3. Reject repeated ids within the file and ids already stored.\n4. Compute each touched account's stored balance plus the file's amounts with `balance_guard`; any\n   result below zero rejects the file.\n5. Only after every check passes, write all rows in one transaction, then print the result.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: confirm every named account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-002` — read: confirm every named category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: read existing ids and balances - supplies: `account`, `category` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\nRows are written through `db.transactions.create`, the operation declared for the post feature in\n`DATABASE.md`; this feature reuses it and declares no operation of its own.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-transactions-valid ===\nIntent: A valid transactions file keeps its file ids, reports the loaded count, and every row reads back.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef counts():\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert rc == 0\n    return {r[0]: int(r[1]) for r in list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))[1:]}\n\ndef load(table, header, rows, tmp):\n    path = os.path.join(tmp, table + \".csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow(header)\n        w.writerows(rows)\n    return cli_runner(\"load\", table, path)\n\nacct, cat = \"LDTXA1\", \"LDTXC1\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    base = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1000\nids = [base + 1, base + 2, base + 3]\nrows = [\n    [ids[0], \"2026-05-01\", acct, cat, \"100.00\", \"deposit\"],\n    [ids[1], \"2026-05-02\", acct, cat, \"-25.50\", \"payment\"],\n    [ids[2], \"2026-05-03\", acct, cat, \"10.25\", \"\"],\n]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n    assert load(\"accounts\", [\"account\", \"name\"], [[acct, \"Load Txn Account\"]], tmp)[0] == 0\n    assert load(\"categories\", [\"category\", \"description\"], [[cat, \"Load Txn Category\"]], tmp)[0] == 0\n    before = counts()\n    rc, out, err = load(\n        \"transactions\", [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"], rows, tmp\n    )\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert rc == 0\nparsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", str(len(rows))]]\nassert counts()[\"transactions\"] == before[\"transactions\"] + len(rows)\ncents = [10000, -2550, 1025]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for row, c in zip(rows, cents):\n        got = db.transactions.get(txn_id=row[0])\n        assert got is not None\n        assert got.date == row[1]\n        assert got.account == acct\n        assert got.category == cat\n        assert got.amount == c\n        assert got.memo == row[5]\n=== END AC load-transactions-valid ===\n\n=== AC FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md, FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md, FEATURE-Count.md |\n| Provides | atomic load rejection |\n| Consumes | ledger load accounts, ledger load categories, ledger load transactions, ledger count |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nProve and enforce the all-or-nothing rule for loads: a file with one invalid row stores none of\nits rows. A file of ten valid rows followed by an eleventh naming an unknown account stores none\nof the eleven.\n\n## Behavior\n\n| Scenario | Result |\n|---|---|\n| Transactions file whose last row names an unknown account | Exit 3, nothing on stdout, no table changes. |\n| Transactions file with an invalid amount, date, or duplicate id on a late row | Exit 3, no table changes. |\n| Accounts file reloaded after it was loaded | Exit 3, no table changes. |\n| Categories file reloaded after it was loaded | Exit 3, no table changes. |\n\nRow counts of all three tables read through `ledger count` are identical before and after every\nrejected command.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: verify no transaction row was stored - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `account`, `amount`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: verify no account row was stored - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-rejection-eleventh-row ===\nIntent: Ten valid rows followed by an unknown-account row are rejected with exit 3 and none of the eleven is stored.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef counts():\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert rc == 0\n    return {r[0]: int(r[1]) for ===\n# FEATURE: Account Add\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger account add <code> <name>`, which creates one validated account. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-Count.md |\n| Provides | ledger account add |\n| Consumes | cli.main, format_amount, validate_code, validate_text |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nAdd a new place where the shop keeps cash. A new account has no transactions and a zero balance.\n\n## Command Contract\n\n`ledger account add <code> <name>` registers under the `account` command in the cli command table.\n\n| Condition | Result |\n|---|---|\n| Valid code and name, code not in use | Exit 0. Stdout is `account,name,transactions,balance` then the new row with `0` transactions and balance `0.00`. |\n| Wrong argument count | Exit 2, nothing on stdout. |\n| Code not 1 to 12 characters of `A-Z0-9` | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| Name empty, longer than 40 characters, or containing a comma or newline | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| Code already exists | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Validate the code and name with the `ledger-core` validators.\n2. Confirm the code is not already stored.\n3. Create the row, then print the account row. The transaction count and balance are computed from\n   the database, never hard-coded, and formatted from integer cents with two decimal places.\n4. A failing command writes one diagnostic line to standard error and nothing to standard output.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-003` — write: create an account - supplies: `account`, `name` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: detect an existing code - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: count the account's transactions and sum its balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC account-add-valid ===\nIntent: Adding a valid account prints its zero-balance row and the account reads back with the supplied name.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode = \"ADDOK1\"\nname = \"Added Account\"\nrc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, name)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert rc == 0\nrows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert rows == [[\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"], [code, name, \"0\", \"0.00\"]]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    got = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n    assert got is not None\n    assert got.name == name\n=== END AC account-add-valid ===\n\n=== AC account-add-boundaries ===\nIntent: A 12-character code and a 40-character name are accepted.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode = \"ADDMAXCODE12\"\nname = \"N\" * 40\nassert len(code) == 12\nrc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, name)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert rc == 0\nrows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert rows[1][:2] == [code, name]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    got = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n    assert got is not None\n    assert got.name == name\n=== END AC account-add-boundaries ===\n\n=== AC account-add-invalid-code ===\nIntent: A code that is too long, lowercase, or contains a forbidden character is rejected with exit 3 and not stored.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nbad_codes = [\"ADDBADCODE123X\", \"addlower\", \"ADD-DASH\", \"ADD SPACE\"]\nfor code in bad_codes:\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, \"Some Name\")\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert rc == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for code in bad_codes:\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n=== END AC account-add-invalid-code ===\n\n=== AC account-add-invalid-name ===\nIntent: A name that is empty, longer than 40 characters, or holds a comma or newline is rejected with exit 3 and not stored.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nbad_names = [\"\", \"N\" * 41, \"has,comma\", \"has\\nnewline\"]\nfor n, name in enumerate(bad_names, start=1):\n    code = \"ADDBN%d\" % n\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, name)\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert rc == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for n in range(1, len(bad_names) + 1):\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=\"ADDBN%d\" % n) is None\n=== END AC account-add-invalid-name ===\n\n=== AC account-add-usage ===\nIntent: Missing or extra arguments to account add are a usage error (exit 2) and store nothing.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode = \"ADDUSE1\"\nrc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code)\nprint(out, err)\nassert rc == 2\nassert out == \"\"\nrc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, \"Name\", \"extra\")\nprint(out, err)\nassert rc == 2\nassert out == \"\"\nrc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\")\nprint(out, err)\nassert rc == 2\nassert out == \"\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n=== END AC account-add-usage ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- The transaction count and balance in the printed row are computed from the database.\n- Balances are integer cents formatted to two decimal places; no floating point is used.\n- A rejected add changes nothing.\n=== END ARTIFACT loads accounts from a CSV file all-or-nothing. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-Count.md |\n| Provides | ledger load accounts |\n| Consumes | cli.main, parse_amount, validate_code, validate_text |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nBulk-load account rows from a CSV file so the shop's drawers, safe, and petty cash exist before\ntransactions are loaded. The command either stores every row or stores nothing.\n\n## Command Contract\n\n`ledger load accounts <csv>` registers under the `load` command in the cli command table.\n\n| Condition | Result |\n|---|---|\n| File readable, header equals `account,name`, every row valid | Exit 0. Stdout is `table,loaded` then `accounts,<rows>`. |\n| Missing `<csv>` argument or extra arguments | Exit 2, nothing on stdout. |\n| File missing or unreadable | Exit 1, nothing on stdout. |\n| Header differs from the table columns in name or order | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| A row has an invalid code or name (see Rules 3 and 4) | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| A code repeats within the file | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| A code already exists in the `accounts` table | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Read the whole file and parse it with the standard `csv` module.\n2. Check the header, then check every row with the `ledger-core` validators, the duplicate-in-file\n   rule, and the duplicate-in-table rule. All checks complete before the first write.\n3. Write every row in one transaction through the persistence library, then print the result.\n4. A failing command writes one diagnostic line to standard error and nothing to standard output.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: detect codes already stored - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n\nRows are written through `db.accounts.create`, the operation declared for the account feature in\n`DATABASE.md`; this feature reuses it and declares no operation of its own.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-accounts-valid ===\nIntent: A valid accounts file loads, reports the loaded count, and every row reads back.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef counts():\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert rc == 0\n    return {r[0]: int(r[1]) for r in list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))[1:]}\n\ncodes = [\"LDACC1\", \"LDACC2\", \"LDACC3\"]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n    path = os.path.join(tmp, \"accounts.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerows([[c, \"Name \" + c] for c in codes])\n    before = counts()\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert rc == 0\nrows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert rows == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"accounts\", str(len(codes))]]\nassert counts()[\"accounts\"] == before[\"accounts\"] + len(codes)\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for c in codes:\n        got = db.accounts.get(account=c)\n        assert got is not None\n        assert got.name == \"Name \" + c\n=== END AC load-accounts-valid ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-header ===\nIntent: A file whose header does not match the table columns is rejected with exit 3 and stores nothing.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode = \"LDHDR1\"\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n    path = os.path.join(tmp, \"accounts.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"code\", \"label\"])\n        w.writerow([code, \"Wrong Header\"])\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert rc == 3\nassert out == \"\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n=== END AC load-accounts-header ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-atomic ===\nIntent: An invalid row rejects the whole file so no earlier row is stored.\n\nimport csv\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ngood = \"LDATM1\"\nbad = \"bad code\"\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n    path = os.path.join(tmp, \"accounts.csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerow([good, \"Good Row\"])\n        w.writerow([bad, \"Bad Row\"])\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", path)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert rc == 3\nassert out == \"\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    assert db.accounts.get(account=good) is None\n=== END AC load-accounts-atomic ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-duplicates ===\nIntent: A code repeated inside the file, or already stored, is rejected with exit 3 and nothing is added.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\ndef counts():\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert rc == 0\n    return {r[0]: int(r[1]) for r in list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))[1:]}\n\ndef write(path, rows):\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow([\"account\", \"name\"])\n        w.writerows(rows)\n\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n    dup_file = os.path.join(tmp, \"dup.csv\")\n    write(dup_file, [[\"LDDUP1\", \"One\"], [\"LDDUP1\", \"Two\"]])\n    before = counts()\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", dup_file)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert rc == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert counts() == before\n\n    once = os.path.join(tmp, \"once.csv\")\n    write(once, [[\"LDDUP2\", \"Only\"]])\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", once)\n    assert rc == 0\n    after_first = counts()\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", once)\n    print(out, err)\n    assert rc == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\n    assert counts() == after_first\n=== END AC load-accounts-duplicates ===\n\n=== AC load-accounts-usage-and-io ===\nIntent: A missing argument is a usage error (exit 2) and an unreadable file is an operational failure (exit 1).\n\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\n\nrc, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\")\nprint(out, err)\nassert rc == 2\nassert out == \"\"\n\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n    missing = os.path.join(tmp, \"absent.csv\")\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"load\", \"accounts\", missing)\nprint(out, err)\nassert rc == 1\nassert out == \"\"\n=== END AC load-accounts-usage-and-io ===\n\n## User Acceptance\n\n- None.\n\n## Guardrails\n\n- No account is stored unless every row of the file is valid.\n- Application code never reads `sources/` seed files; the file path comes only from the command line.\n- All database access goes through the shipped persistence library.\n=== END ARTIFACT ===\n=== BEGIN ARTIFACT FEATURE-LoadCategories.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Categories\n\n| Field | Read the whole file with the standard `csv` module and check the header.\n2. FEATURE-LoadTransactions.md ===\n# FEATURE: Load Transactions\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger load transactions <csv>`, which loads transactions keeping their file ids, all-or-nothing. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, FEATURE-LoadAccounts.md, FEATURE-LoadCategories.md |\n| Provides | ledger load transactions |\n| Consumes | cli.main, parse_amount, validate_text, validate_date, balance_guard, ledger load accounts, ledger load categories |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nBulk-load transaction rows. Each loaded transaction keeps the `txn_id` written in its file. The\ncommand either stores every row or stores nothing.\n\n## Command Contract\n\n`ledger load transactions <csv>` registers under the `load` command in the cli command table.\n\n| Condition | Result |\n|---|---|\n| File readable, header equals `txn_id,date,account,category,amount,memo`, every row valid, resulting balances non-negative | Exit 0. Stdout is `table,loaded` then `transactions,<rows>`. |\n| Missing `<csv>` argument or extra arguments | Exit 2, nothing on stdout. |\n| File missing or unreadable | Exit 1, nothing on stdout. |\n| Header mismatch; non-integer `txn_id`; bad date, amount, or memo | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| Unknown account or unknown category | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| A `txn_id` repeats within the file or already exists in the table | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| Loading would leave any account balance below zero | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Read the whole file with the standard `csv` module and check the header.\n2. For each row validate the id, the date (a real calendar date), the amount (`-?DIGITS[.D[D]]`,\n   never zero, parsed to integer cents), the memo (0 to 60 characters, no comma or newline), and\n   that the account and category exist.\n3. Reject repeated ids within the file and ids already stored.\n4. Compute each touched account's stored balance plus the file's amounts with `balance_guard`; any\n   result below zero rejects the file.\n5. Only after every check passes, write all rows in one transaction, then print the result.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: confirm every named account exists - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-CATEGORY-002` — read: confirm every named category exists - supplies: `category` - returns: `category`, `description`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: read existing ids and balances - supplies: `account`, `category` - returns: `txn_id`, `date`, `account`, `category`, `amount`, `memo`\n\nRows are written through `db.transactions.create`, the operation declared for the post feature in\n`DATABASE.md`; this feature reuses it and declares no operation of its own.\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC load-transactions-valid ===\nIntent: A valid transactions file keeps its file ids, reports the loaded count, and every row reads back.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nimport os\nimport tempfile\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ndef counts():\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"count\")\n    assert rc == 0\n    return {r[0]: int(r[1]) for r in list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))[1:]}\n\ndef load(table, header, rows, tmp):\n    path = os.path.join(tmp, table + \".csv\")\n    with open(path, \"w\", newline=\"\") as fh:\n        w = csv.writer(fh, lineterminator=\"\\n\")\n        w.writerow(header)\n        w.writerows(rows)\n    return cli_runner(\"load\", table, path)\n\nacct, cat = \"LDTXA1\", \"LDTXC1\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    base = max([t.txn_id for t in db.transactions.list()], default=0) + 1000\nids = [base + 1, base + 2, base + 3]\nrows = [\n    [ids[0], \"2026-05-01\", acct, cat, \"100.00\", \"deposit\"],\n    [ids[1], \"2026-05-02\", acct, cat, \"-25.50\", \"payment\"],\n    [ids[2], \"2026-05-03\", acct, cat, \"10.25\", \"\"],\n]\nwith tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:\n    assert load(\"accounts\", [\"account\", \"name\"], [[acct, \"Load Txn Account\"]], tmp)[0] == 0\n    assert load(\"categories\", [\"category\", \"description\"], [[cat, \"Load Txn Category\"]], tmp)[0] == 0\n    before = counts()\n    rc, out, err = load(\n        \"transactions\", [\"txn_id\", \"date\", \"account\", \"category\", \"amount\", \"memo\"], rows, tmp\n    )\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert rc == 0\nparsed = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert parsed == [[\"table\", \"loaded\"], [\"transactions\", str(len(rows))]]\nassert counts()[\"transactions\"] == before[\"transactions\"] + len(rows)\ncents = [10000, -2550, 1025]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for row, c in zip(rows, cents):\n        got = db.transactions.get(txn_id=row[0])\n        assert got is not None\n        assert got.date == ledger load transactions, ledger count |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nProve and enforce the all-or-nothing rule for loads: a file with one invalid row stores none of\nits rows. A file of ten valid rows followed by an eleventh naming an unknown account stores none\nof the eleven.\n\n## Behavior\n\n| Scenario | Result |\n|---|---|\n| Transactions file whose last row names an unknown account | Exit 3, nothing on stdout, no table changes. |\n| Transactions file with an invalid amount, date, or duplicate id on a late row | Exit 3, no table changes. |\n| Accounts file are identical before and after every\nrejected command.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: verify no transaction row was stored - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, ===\n# FEATURE: Account Add\n\n| Field | Value |\n|-------|-------|\n| Version | 20261025 V1 |\n| Description | Implements `ledger account add <code> <name>`, which creates one validated account. |\n| Depends On | ARCHITECTURE.md, DATABASE.md, FEATURE-CliEntry.md, FEATURE-LedgerCore.md, FEATURE-Init.md, FEATURE-Count.md |\n| Provides | ledger account add |\n| Consumes | cli.main, format_amount, validate_code, validate_text |\n\n## Questions\n\n- None.\n\n## Purpose\n\nAdd a new place where the shop keeps cash. A new account has no transactions and a zero balance.\n\n## Command Contract\n\n`ledger account add <code> <name>` registers under the `account` command in the cli command table.\n\n| Condition | Result |\n|---|---|\n| Valid code and name, code not in use | Exit 0. Stdout is `account,name,transactions,balance` then the new row with `0` transactions and balance `0.00`. |\n| Wrong argument count | Exit 2, nothing on stdout. |\n| Code not 1 to 12 characters of `A-Z0-9` | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| Name empty, longer than 40 characters, or containing a comma or newline | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n| Code already exists | Exit 3, nothing stored. |\n\n## Behavior\n\n1. Validate the code and name with the `ledger-core` validators.\n2. Confirm the code is not already stored.\n3. Create the row, then print the account row. The transaction count and balance are computed from\n   the database, never hard-coded, and formatted from integer cents with two decimal places.\n4. A failing command writes one diagnostic line to standard error and nothing to standard output.\n\n## Database Interface\n\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-003` — write: create an account - supplies: `account`, `name` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-ACCOUNT-002` — read: detect an existing code - supplies: `account` - returns: `account`, `name`\n- `FEATURE-TXN-002` — read: count the account's transactions and sum its balance - supplies: `account` - returns: `txn_id`, `amount`\n\n## Programmatic Acceptance\n\n=== AC account-add-valid ===\nIntent: Adding a valid account prints its zero-balance row and the account reads back with the supplied name.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode = \"ADDOK1\"\nname = \"Added Account\"\nrc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, name)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert rc == 0\nrows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert rows == [[\"account\", \"name\", \"transactions\", \"balance\"], [code, name, \"0\", \"0.00\"]]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    got = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n    assert got is not None\n    assert got.name == name\n=== END AC account-add-valid ===\n\n=== AC account-add-boundaries ===\nIntent: A 12-character code and a 40-character name are accepted.\n\nimport csv\nimport io\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\ncode = \"ADDMAXCODE12\"\nname = \"N\" * 40\nassert len(code) == 12\nrc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, name)\nprint(out)\nprint(err)\nassert rc == 0\nrows = list(csv.reader(io.StringIO(out)))\nassert rows[1][:2] == [code, name]\nwith db_session() as db:\n    got = db.accounts.get(account=code)\n    assert got is not None\n    assert got.name == name\n=== END AC account-add-boundaries ===\n\n=== AC account-add-invalid-code ===\nIntent: A code that is too long, lowercase, or contains a forbidden character is rejected with exit 3 and not stored.\n\nfrom cli.testing import cli_runner\nfrom persistence.testing import db_session\n\nbad_codes = [\"ADDBADCODE123X\", \"addlower\", \"ADD-DASH\", \"ADD SPACE\"]\nfor code in bad_codes:\n    rc, out, err = cli_runner(\"account\", \"add\", code, \"Some Name\")\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert rc == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for code in bad_codes:\n        assert db.accounts.get(account=code) is None\n=== END AC account-add-invalid-code ===\n\n=== AC account-add-invalid-name ===\nIntent: A name \"add\", code, name)\n    print(code, out, err)\n    assert rc == 3\n    assert out == \"\"\nwith db_session() as db:\n    for n in range(1, len(bad_names) + 1):\n        assert
